english.title: Drive a vehicle for more than 4.5 hours without a break - AETR
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for more than four and a half hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVING PERIOD..), without a rest break in contravention of Article 7.1 of the European Agreement Concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles Engaged in International Road Transport
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) Temporary exception during the period from 22nd January 2021 and ending with 31st March 2021 whilst driver is in Kent and undertaking a relevant journey: see regulation 3(3) and (4) of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) Regulations 2021, where a driver may replace the uninterrupted break after a driving period of four and a half hours by a break of at least 15 minutes followed by one or two breaks totalling at least 30 minutes, each of at least 15 minutes, and each distributed over the period.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) for more than four and a half hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRIVING PERIOD..), without a rest break in contravention of Article 7.1 of the European Agreement Concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles Engaged in International Road Transport.
